title.zh: 拨款61,304元16分本地货币，用于支付群岛政府向Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia购买的马尼拉市Malate区Calle San Andres两块土地的剩余价款，并赔偿该地块的部分租户。
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING SIXTY-ONE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND FOUR DOLLARS AND SIXTEEN CENTS, LOCAL CURRENCY, TO PAY THE REMAINDER OF THE PURCHASE PRICE OF TWO PARCELS OF LAND SITUATED ON CALLE SAN ANDRES, IN THE DISTRICT OF MALATE, CITY OF MANILA, PURCHASED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FROM EULALIA GABRIELA IGNACIA, AND TO INDEMNIFY CERTAIN TENANTS OF SAID PARCELS OF LAND.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING SIXTY-ONE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND FOUR DOLLARS AND SIXTEEN CENTS, LOCAL CURRENCY, TO PAY THE REMAINDER OF THE PURCHASE PRICE OF TWO PARCELS OF LAND SITUATED ON CALLE SAN ANDRES, IN THE DISTRICT OF MALATE, CITY OF MANILA, PURCHASED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FROM EULALIA GABRIELA IGNACIA, AND TO INDEMNIFY CERTAIN TENANTS OF SAID PARCELS OF LAND.
title.vi: Luật cấp 61.304 đơn vị tiền tệ địa phương và 16 xu để thanh toán phần giá mua còn lại của hai thửa đất trên Calle San Andres, quận Malate, Manila, do chính quyền quần đảo mua từ Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia, đồng thời bồi thường cho một số người thuê đất.
title.th: กฎหมายจัดสรรเงินสกุลท้องถิ่น 61,304 หน่วยกับ 16 เซนต์เพื่อชำระราคาซื้อส่วนที่เหลือของที่ดินสองแปลงบน Calle San Andres เขต Malate เมืองมะนิลา ซึ่งรัฐบาลหมู่เกาะซื้อจาก Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia และชดเชยแก่ผู้เช่าที่ดินบางราย
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengalokasikan 61.304 dolar dan 16 sen mata uang lokal untuk membayar sisa harga pembelian dua bidang tanah di Calle San Andres, distrik Malate, Manila, yang dibeli pemerintah kepulauan dari Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia, serta memberi ganti rugi kepada sejumlah penyewa tanah tersebut.
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan 61,304 unit mata wang tempatan dan 16 sen untuk membayar baki harga pembelian dua bidang tanah di Calle San Andres, daerah Malate, Manila, yang dibeli kerajaan kepulauan daripada Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia, serta membayar pampasan kepada beberapa penyewa tanah tersebut.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of sixty-one thousand three hundred and four dollars and sixteen cents, local currency, to pay the
remainder of the purchase price of two parcels of land situated on Calle San Andres, of the district of Malate,
city of Manila, purchased by the Insular Government from Eulalia Gabriela Ignacia, and to pay
indemnification to certain mesne tenants of paid parcels of land, as their interests may appear, out of the
purchase price.

The payment of said purchase price and indemnification shall be made by settlement warrants of
the Insular Auditor only upon the certificate of the Solicitor-General according to the contract of sale above
mentioned; and, in case all those having mesne tenant rights in said parcels of land do not surrender the same
by proper conveyance, a sufficient amount of the purchase price, under the contract and as stipulated therein,
shall remain in the Insular Treasury to be paid on warrant of the Auditor to the person adjudged entitled in
proper condemnation proceedings.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 27, 1903.
